column1: # Pokemon Pokopia (Switch 2, update v655360). Plays on the Mac
# Koei Tecmo's KTGL (KTSL2 sound), SDK 20.5.25 built for the Switch 2 (Ounce), NVN2. Modules main + subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie: WebM movies) + sdk.
# Packed from a dump folder (base/exefs, updates/<version>/) with scripts/pack_dump.py. RomFS: the newer RDB of ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8 REMAKE under motor_asset_re/KIDS_PLATFORM_OUNCE
# v655360 is the update's title version; a dump has no control data to name a display version

# The Switch 2 leaves games 9 GB of its 12 GB (Donkey Kong Bananza's figure). The game takes all of it with SetHeapSize (8.92 GB) and makes 4,988 MiB of memory pools in it; the opening touches 4.6 GB (phone, README.md Memory). The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): no virtual address memory.
# 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 9 GB heap region
# nninitStartup asks for pool - used memory and does not check the answer; the rewritten modules take 82 MB, more than the default 64 MB SetHeapSize checks the request against
# KTGL's dynamic resolution: a table of 34 sizes at main+0x2849658 (u32 widths, then heights: level 0 = 960x540 up by 32x18 to level 30 = 1920x1080, then 1440p, 4K, 8K) and
# nine level lists the controller (main+0x22cd20) walks down when the GPU runs late, picked at main+0x22d338 by oe::GetOperationMode, oe::GetCurrentGraphicsScale and a flag:
# docked at scale 1 it starts at level 24 (1728x972), docked at scale 0 at 30, handheld at 20 (1600x900). The host lowers the lists that start above DM_WINDOW_SIZE
# (the Android launcher's Game resolution; loader.c levels_apply), the table stays: the game's own maximum must stay, or the terrain breaks (the game note, Render size)
# Update 327680 (an untested build, packed with Try anyway), main build 816c5358…: the same table and nine lists, found in its main (NS2Droid-Flip2, 2026-11-10).
# The table at main+0x2756530 (heights at +0x27565b8: the getters at main+0x103a1e0 / +0x103a220); the lists picked at main+0x1fb7a0..0x1fb93c, adrp+add each, with
